day_shape: 65 items: Pakistan PM and Iran FM Araghchi say a US-Iran 'Islamabad agreement' text is agreed (Mehr cites $12bn unfreeze), IDF claims 10+ Hezbollah field commanders killed and 310 Lebanon targets struck in past week, CENTCOM reports 136 vessels redirected and 9 disabled enforcing Iran blockade.

threads.label: US-Iran 'Islamabad agreement' near finalisation
threads.summary: Pakistani PM Shehbaz Sharif and Iranian FM Abbas Araghchi said an agreed text between Iran and the US had been reached, with Pakistan mediating final steps. Mehr, cited by the Jerusalem Post, reported the deal would include an end to fighting in Lebanon and initial unfreezing of $12bn; Araghchi and France's Barrot also spoke by phone on the process.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Hezbollah command in south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it had killed more than 10 Hezbollah field commanders, including Nasr Unit commander Hajj Salameh and successors Mahdi Bazzi and Ashraf Salloum, and reported ~310 targets struck and ~80 operatives killed in Lebanon over the past week. The military also announced a completed raid in Dibbine with 50+ targets struck, issued evacuation orders for Sarafand, Taffah and Mazraat Shina, and reported two suspected Hezbollah drone strikes near troops with no injuries.

threads.label: Regime narrative on war outcome and US weakness
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted that 'America's ramshackle bases lack the capacity to even secure themselves,' while IRIB and Defa Press circulated Channel 13 and MS NOW segments framing Iran as having emerged stronger and Trump as repeatedly cancelling ultimatums. IRIB and Defa Press also published satellite imagery they said showed damage from Iranian missile strikes on the Sheikh Isa air base in Bahrain.

threads.label: US blockade and CENTCOM regional posture
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US Navy warships and air assets continue to enforce a blockade against Iran, with 136 commercial vessels redirected and 9 disabled to date. CENTCOM also announced completion of its largest training exercise with central and south Asian nations, involving 350+ personnel from 10 countries and 10 US National Guard units.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and stalled mediation
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed three Palestinian operatives in Gaza — PIJ platoon commanders Qasslam Saleh and Sami Abu Dalal and Hamas deputy company commander Ubay Farwana — and struck three Hamas weapons depots in central Gaza overnight. Times of Israel reported Gaza mediators were glum on chances of a breakthrough before Israeli elections, while Hamas co-founder Hassan Yousef, 71, was released from Israeli administrative detention.

threads.label: Iran's foreign partnerships messaging
threads.summary: Pezeshkian sent a message to Putin marking Russia's national day, saying he was confident the Iran-Russia strategic partnership would deepen further. IRIB also reported India's agriculture minister telling his Iranian counterpart that Delhi attached 'special importance' to expanded cooperation in agriculture, technology and research.

threads.label: UK drone centre cites Iran lessons
threads.summary: Defence Secretary Dan Jarvis opened what gov.uk described as Europe's largest drone testing centre in Swindon, citing lessons from the Ukraine and Iran conflicts. The announcement came alongside a US CFTC Federal Register proposal on prediction-market event contracts, with no UK Parliament activity on the day.

events.title: Prediction Markets; Public Interest Determinations
events.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (Commission or CFTC) is proposing amendments to its rules concerning event contract derivatives. The markets for these event contracts are commonly referred to as "prediction markets." In particular, the Commission is proposing amendments to further specify the types of event contracts that may be subject to a determination that they are contrary to the public interest, such that they may not be listed for trading or accepted for clearing on or through a CFTC-registered entity, as provided in the Commodity Exchange Act (CEA). The proposed amendments set out factors the Commission would apply in that determination and conform the process by which the determination would be made to the CEA. The Commission also is proposing amendments to the procedure for the Commission's determination to enhance clarity and organization, as well as a definition of the term "gaming" and a rule regarding when event contracts "involve" an underlying activity.
